strings.subtitle: — Fa'aumatia faila —
strings.no_file: E leai se faila na filifilia
strings.dnd_hint: (pe toso se faila i lenei faamalama)
strings.dnd_unavailable: E le maua le toso ma le tu'u. Fa'aoga le ki i lalo.
strings.ft_lnk: Auala puupuu (.lnk) — o le a teena
strings.strategy_full: ☢  AT OA — mea uma i le zero (saogalemu)
strings.shred_button: F A ' A U M A T I A
strings.ssd_warning:
Lapata'iga! I luga o le SSD, o le auala e tusi ai i luga e le mautinoa ai le fa'aumatiaga ona o le TRIM.
O lenei polokalama e mo le HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
O le faila "{name}" o le a tusia i luga ma tapeina.

Fa'aauau?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
E le mafai ona faitau le faila:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  UA TUSIA LE FAILA I LUGA MA TAPEINA
strings.report_limits:
• O isi ala o fa'amatalaga NTFS (ADS) e le o fa'agaoioia.
• E le fa'amama le tusi o USN.
• O kopi o le ata ma feso'ota'iga o le ao
  (OneDrive ma isi) e le a'afia.
strings.step_delete: Tape e ala i le pe'ape'a
strings.status_full: O mea o lo'o i totonu ua tusia atoa i luga i le zero. E le mafai ona toe maua — o mea faigaluega o le a na'o le zero.
strings.status_fast: Ulu, si'usi'u ma laina 4 MB ua tusia i luga. O le vaega o totoe e le'i pa'i, ae ona o va, e le mafai e mea faigaluega fa'atau ona toe maua atoa. Mo pepa fa'alilolilo fa'aoga le faiga AT OA.
strings.status_empty: Sa gaogao le faila, e le'i mana'omia le tusia i luga. Ua tapeina.
strings.error_permission: E le mafai ona maua le faila. Atonu o lo'o tatala i se isi polokalama. Tapuni ma toe taumafai.
strings.error_not_found: E le'i maua le faila. Atonu ua uma ona tapeina.
strings.error_is_symlink: O se so'otaga fa'atusa lea. E le mafai ona fa'aumatia so'otaga — o le faila fa'amoemoe o le a tumau pea.
strings.error_reparse: O se faila nofoaga lea (OneDrive pe tutusa). O ana fa'amatalaga o lo'o i le ao, e le o luga o le tisiki — e leai se mea e fa'aumatia iinei.
strings.error_not_file: E le o se faila lea (faila po'o se isi mea). Tu'u se faila.
strings.error_hardlinks: O lenei faila e iai isi so'otaga malō ({n} uma). E leai se matai o so'otaga malō — e tutusa uma igoa. A e fa'aumatia i le ala o lo'o iai nei, o le a tusia fa'amatalaga i luga ma tipi i le 32 byte, ae o le vaega e totoe o le a mafai ona maua e ala i isi so'otaga. Tape muamua uma so'otaga.
strings.error_compressed:
O le faila ua fa'aopoopo, fa'alilolilo pe manifinifi. O le tusia i luga i le zero e le mautinoa ai le fa'aumatiaga o fa'amatalaga tuai ona o le NTFS e teuina i se isi auala.

Aveese le uiga: kiliki taumatau → Uiga → Maualuga → aveese le faailoga i le Fa'aopoopo ma/po'o le Fa'alilolilo. Ona toe fa'agaoioi lea o le SHREDDER.
